description: This file declares the interface for a data structure called inst_sel_vector_t, which manages a collection of instance number-based selectors used for implementing instance-based permissions. It defines initialization, destruction, modification, and query functions related to this vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys an inst_sel_vector_t structure, optionally destroying its entries.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Unwatch
methods.description: Performs cleanup or unwatch operations on the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Fill
methods.description: Fills the vector with a specified number of entries and permission bitmask.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a selector to the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a selector at a specific index from the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_Find
methods.description: Finds the index of a given selector within the vector.

methods.name: INST_SEL_VECTOR_GetPermissionForInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the permission bits for a specific instance.
